    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Admin
    Represents an Admin user in the TicketMiner system.
    AdminMenu
    Handles the Admin menu and all admin-specific management operations for users, venues, and events.
    Arena
    Represents an Arena venue in the TicketMiner system.
    Auditorium
    Represents an Auditorium venue in the TicketMiner system.
    Concert
    Represents a Concert event in the TicketMiner system.
    Customer
    Represents a Customer user in the TicketMiner system.
    CustomerMenu
    Handles the Customer menu including ticket purchasing, order history, and event viewing.
    DataManager
    Handles loading and searching of user, venue, and event data.
    Event
    Abstract base class representing a generic event in the TicketMiner system.
    EventManageable
    Interface defining event management operations for the TicketMiner system.
    EventNotFoundException
    Custom exception thrown when an event cannot be found in the system.
    InputReader
    Utility class providing validated console input methods shared across menu classes.
    Logger
    Utility class for logging actions taken within the TicketMiner system.
    OpenAir
    Represents an Open Air venue in the TicketMiner system.
    Organizer
    Represents an Organizer user in the TicketMiner system.
    OrganizerMenu
    Handles the Organizer menu and all organizer-specific event management operations.
    RunTicketMiner
    Main class for the TicketMiner application.
    Special
    Represents a Special event in the TicketMiner system.
    Sport
    Represents a Sport event in the TicketMiner system.
    Stadium
    Represents a Stadium venue in the TicketMiner system.
    User
    Abstract base class representing a generic user in the TicketMiner system.
    Venue
    Abstract base class representing a generic venue in the TicketMiner system.
